plain: The spreading of false charges to harm someone's name.

webster.text: False accusation of a crime or offense, or a malicious and false representation of the words or actions of another, with a view to injure his good name.

example.quote: Faithful to the true principles of the federal union, unconscious of any designs to disturb the harmony of that Union, and anxious only to escape the fangs of despotism, the good people of this commonwealth are regardless of censure or calumniation.
